title: Exact decimal parsing preserves coefficient and scale
summary: Three adjacent or signed decimals return BigDecimal with the coefficient and scale specified by their text. Float, Integer and malformed controls keep their types.

change.description: Three adjacent or signed decimals return BigDecimal with the coefficient and scale specified by their text. Float, Integer and malformed controls keep their types.

notes: Three explicit exact-decimal strings, each paired with an unchanged short literal and the malformed token 1eE.
The captured original module and its dependencies are identified by SHA-256. The setup record retains build and historical regression evidence.
